meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，你的 AI 助理将获得一个 WhatsApp 频道，可直接通过 WhatsApp 与用户聊天。必须完成号码安全检查（区分专用号码和常用号码）并通过 QR 码或配对码链接设备。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 WhatsApp”或要求通过 WhatsApp 与你的助理互动时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 WhatsApp 频道。
say.note: 启动安装流程，会询问号码类型。

say.text: 我想用 QR 码链接 WhatsApp。
say.note: 跳过询问，直接选择 QR 认证方式。

say.text: 我的 WhatsApp 号码是常用号码。
say.note: 触发共享号码风险警告并需要确认。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, your AI assistant gains a WhatsApp channel, enabling direct WhatsApp communication with users. Requires a number safety check (dedicated vs. shared) and device linking via QR code or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel, or want to interact with your AI assistant via WhatsApp.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel for me.
say_en.note: Starts installation, asks about number type.

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp using a QR code.
say_en.note: Skips question, goes straight to QR auth.

say_en.text: My WhatsApp number is my personal one.
say_en.note: Triggers shared-number risk warning and confirmation.
